name: Erlebnistherme Zillertal
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen delivers year-round thermal fun with mega slides, wave pool, brine pools, and a sauna village.
preis: 3-hour thermal bath adults approx. €18.50 (children discounted; sauna admission extra)
beschreibung:
Overview

The modern, family-friendly thermal spa Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen at the picturesque entrance of the lower Zillertal is the premier wellness, leisure, and aquatic resort in the valley. Framed by the panoramic backdrop of the Zillertal and Tux Alps, this expansive aquatic paradise offers year-round, weather-independent recreation, swimming fun, and regeneration for visitors of all generations. While children and families revel in thrilling waterslides, lazy river currents, and engaging wave pools, wellness guests and sauna enthusiasts find a tranquil haven of peace in the generous spa wing. The pleasantly warm thermal and saltwater pools indoors and outdoors are enriched with restorative minerals that promote muscular recovery and deep relaxation following a winter day on the slopes or an energetic summer hike.

Route & Requirements

The entire thermal complex is designed with contemporary, threshold-free, and fully accessible architecture, allowing wheelchair users and families with prams to navigate the facilities without difficulty. Visitors need only standard swimwear, pool sandals, and towels; bathrobes can be rented on site. Water attractions are varied and thrilling: the 133-meter-long 'Black Hole' adventure tube slide with light effects and speed timing, along with the fast tyre slide, delight young swimmers. Toddlers enjoy a dedicated splash area with mini pools and interactive water toys. Those seeking tranquility unwind in the large sauna world featuring eight distinct saunas, including a stone-pine sauna, steam rooms, tepidarium, and a beautifully landscaped sauna garden with mountain vistas.

Visit & Arrival

Erlebnistherme Zillertal is open year-round daily from 10:00 to 22:00 (short maintenance closure in autumn; sauna opens at 11:00). Tickets can be purchased at the admissions desk or booked conveniently online. Drivers travel via the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Zillertal/Wiesing) and continue on the B169 for ten kilometers to Fügen (large free car park directly in front of the baths). Rail passengers take the Zillertalbahn from Jenbach station to the Fügen-Hart stop, walking about ten minutes to the spa.

Tips

Do not miss the hourly ceremonial herbal infusion inside the panoramic outdoor sauna, followed by a brisk plunge into the open-air cold immersion pool. After swimming, dine at the spa restaurant serving hearty Tyrolean dishes, stone-baked pizzas, and fresh salads for the whole family.
